body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:Cairo,"Segoe UI",Tahoma,sans-serif;line-height:1.6}

.bar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}

.top button.lg{background:#ffffff1f;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 12px;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:6px}.tabs button{flex:1;background:#ffffff14;color:#dbe9ff;border:0;padding:10px;border-radius:10px;font:inherit;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
.tabs button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#fff;color:#0a3a8a}
.sheet{margin-top:-40px;padding-bottom:30px}.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px;margin-bottom:14px}
h2{font-size:1.02rem;margin:0 0 12px}.sub{color:var(--mut);font-size:.88rem;margin:-6px 0 12px}
.g2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0 12px}
label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--mut);gap:3px;margin-bottom:12px}
input,select{font:inherit;padding:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);width:100%}
input:focus,select:focus,button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--acc);outline-offset:1px}
.pw-wrap{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center}.pw-wrap input{padding-left:76px}.pw-toggle{position:absolute;left:6px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--acc);font:inherit;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;padding:5px 7px;border-radius:6px}.pw-toggle:hover{background:var(--off)}
.btn{width:100%;background:var(--acc);color:#fff;border:0;padding:12px;border-radius:10px;font:inherit;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
.btn:disabled{background:var(--off);color:var(--mut);cursor:not-allowed}.btn.sm{width:auto;padding:8px 18px}
.btn.ghost{background:none;color:var(--acc);border:1.5px solid var(--acc)}
.doc{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:12px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:10px}
.av{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--acc);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800;flex:none}
.doc>div{flex:1;min-width:0}.doc small{display:block;color:var(--mut)}.pill{display:inline-block;background:#0a5bbf1f;color:var(--acc);border-radius:99px;padding:0 10px;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600}
.days{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:6px}
.day{flex:none;width:64px;padding:8px 0;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:none;color:inherit;font:inherit;text-align:center;cursor:pointer}
.day b{display:block;font-size:1.25rem;line-height:1.2}.day span{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--mut)}
.day[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--acc);border-color:var(--acc);color:#fff}.day[aria-pressed=true] span{color:#e0f5ef}
.slots{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(80px,1fr));gap:8px}
.slot{padding:8px 0;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:none;color:inherit;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
.slot[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--acc);border-color:var(--acc);color:#fff}
.slot:disabled{background:var(--off);color:var(--mut);text-decoration:line-through;cursor:not-allowed;border-color:transparent}
.err{color:var(--bad);font-size:.88rem;min-height:1.3em;margin-bottom:6px}
.empty{text-align:center;color:var(--mut);padding:18px}.link{background:none;border:0;color:var(--acc);font:inherit;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;padding:0}
.ok{text-align:center}.tick{width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--acc);color:#fff;font-size:2rem;display:grid;place-items:center;margin:0 auto 8px}
.ref{display:inline-block;background:var(--off);padding:3px 14px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:800;direction:ltr}
.row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.92rem}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(130px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px}
.stat{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px;border-inline-start:5px solid var(--acc)}.stat b{display:block;font-size:1.7rem;line-height:1.1}.stat span{color:var(--mut);font-size:.85rem}
.sub-tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;overflow-x:auto;margin-bottom:14px}.sub-tabs button{flex:none;background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:8px 14px;border-radius:99px;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
.sub-tabs button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--acc);color:#fff;border-color:var(--acc)}
.tw{overflow-x:auto}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;min-width:480px}th,td{padding:8px;text-align:start;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.9rem}th{color:var(--mut)}
.g3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 2fr 1fr;gap:0 10px}
.rx{background:#fff;color:#111;border:1px solid #bbb;padding:24px;border-radius:6px}.rx header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;border-bottom:3px double #0a5bbf;padding-bottom:10px;margin-bottom:12px}
.rx h3{margin:0;color:#084a9c}.rx small{color:#555}.rx ol{padding-inline-start:22px}.rx li{margin-bottom:10px}.rx footer{margin-top:36px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;color:#555;font-size:.85rem}
.seg{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}.seg button{min-width:48px}.seg button{flex:1;padding:7px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:none;color:inherit;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}.seg button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--acc);color:#fff;border-color:var(--acc)}
.slot.blk{background:var(--bad);border-color:var(--bad);color:#fff;text-decoration:line-through}
.ctc{text-align:center;padding:10px 0 30px;color:var(--mut)}.ctc b{display:block;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:8px}.ctc div{display:flex;gap:8px 18px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}.ctc a{color:var(--acc);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600}
.specs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(130px,1fr));gap:10px}
.spec{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;text-align:center;padding:14px 8px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:none;color:inherit;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
.spec:hover{border-color:var(--acc);background:#0a5bbf0f}.spec .ic{width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:50%;background:#0a5bbf1f;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:1.9rem}
.spec b{font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.3}.spec small{color:var(--mut)}
@media print{.top,.noprint,#ft{display:none!important}body{background:#fff}.sheet{margin:0}.card{border:0;padding:0}.rx{border:0}}

</style>

const $=s=>document.querySelector(s),t=k=>T[S.lang][k];
const esc=s=>String(s??"").replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;"}[c]));
const L=S0=>S.lang==="ar"?0:1,loc=()=>S.lang==="ar"?"ar-DZ":"fr-DZ";
const wl=i=>WIL[i][L()],sl=i=>SPEC[i][L()];
const sha=async s=>[...new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256",new TextEncoder().encode(s)))].map(b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("");
const opts=(a,sel,all)=>(all?`<option value="">${all}</option>`:"")+a.map((x,i)=>`<option value="${i}" ${String(sel)===String(i)?"selected":""}>${esc(x[L()])}</option>`).join("");
const inp=(n,lb,ty="text",ex="")=>`<label>${lb}<input name="${n}" type="${ty}" value="${esc(S.f[n]||"")}" ${ex}></label>`;
const pwInp=(n,lb,ex="")=>`<label>${lb}<span class="pw-wrap"><input name="${n}" type="password" value="${esc(S.f[n]||"")}" ${ex}><button class="pw-toggle" type="button" data-toggle-pw="${n}" aria-label="إظهار كلمة المرور" aria-pressed="false">إظهار</button></span></label>`;
const hrs=(n,lb,v)=>`<label>${lb}<select name="${n}">${Array.from({length:15},(_,i)=>i+7).map(h=>`<option value="${h}" ${(S.f[n]||v)==h?"selected":""}>${h}:00</option>`).join("")}</select></label>`;
const dkey=d=>{const z=new Date(d.getTime()-d.getTimezoneOffset()*6e4);return z.toISOString().slice(0,10)};
function days(dc){const w=(dc&&dc.days)||[0,1,2,3,4],a=[],d=new Date();d.setHours(0,0,0,0);while(a.length<10){d.setDate(d.getDate()+1);if(w.includes(d.getDay()))a.push(new Date(d))}return a}
function slots(d,s=30){const r=[];for(let m=d.from*60;m<=d.to*60-s;m+=s)r.push(Math.floor(m/60)+":"+String(m%60).padStart(2,"0"));return r}
const hash=s=>[...s].reduce((a,c)=>(a*31+c.charCodeAt(0))%97,7);
const taken=(d,k,x)=>BK.some(b=>b.did===d.id&&b.day===k&&b.time===x&&b.st!=="CANCELLED"&&b.st!=="CANCELED");
const field=(n,lb)=>inp(n,lb);

function patient(){
if(S.done){const r=S.done,d=DOCS.find(x=>x.id===r.did);return`<div class="card ok"><div class="tick">✓</div><h2>${t("ok")}</h2><div>${t("ref")}</div><div class="ref">${r.ref}</div>
<div style="margin:14px 0;text-align:start"><div class="row"><span>${t("name")}</span><b>${esc(r.name)}</b></div><div class="row"><span>${t("d").slice(0,0)}${esc(d.name)}</span><b>${sl(d.sp)}</b></div>
<div class="row"><span>${wl(d.w)}</span><b>${new Date(r.day+"T00:00").toLocaleDateString(loc(),{weekday:"long",day:"numeric",month:"long"})} – ${r.time}</b></div></div>
<p>${t("sms")}</p><button class="link" id="again">${t("again")}</button></div>`}
if(S.sel){const d=DOCS.find(x=>x.id===S.sel),D=days(d);if(!S.day)S.day=dkey(D[0]);
return`<div class="card"><button class="link" id="bk">← ${t("back")}</button><div class="doc" style="margin-top:10px;border:0;padding:0"><span class="av">${esc(d.name.replace(/^(Dr|د\.)\s*/,"").charAt(0))}</span><div><b>${esc(d.name)}</b><small>${sl(d.sp)} • ${wl(d.w)} • ${esc(d.addr)}</small>${ph(d)}</div></div></div>
<div class="card"><h2>${t("day")}</h2><div class="days">${D.map(x=>`<button class="day" data-day="${dkey(x)}" aria-pressed="${S.day===dkey(x)}"><span>${x.toLocaleDateString(loc(),{weekday:"short"})}</span><b>${x.getDate()}</b><span>${x.toLocaleDateString(loc(),{month:"short"})}</span></button>`).join("")}</div><label style="margin:10px 0 0">${t("otherDay")}<input type="date" id="dp" value="${S.day}" min="${dkey(new Date(Date.now()+864e5))}" max="${dkey(new Date(Date.now()+90*864e5))}"></label><div class="err">${esc(S.note)}</div></div>
<div class="card"><h2>${t("tm")}</h2><div class="slots">${slots(d,d.step||30).map(x=>`<button class="slot" data-t="${x}" aria-pressed="${S.time===x}" ${taken(d,S.day,x)?"disabled":""}>${x}</button>`).join("")}</div><label style="margin:12px 0 0">${t("exact")}<input type="time" id="ct" step="300" min="${String(d.from).padStart(2,"0")}:00" max="${String(d.to).padStart(2,"0")}:00" value="${S.time?S.time.padStart(5,"0"):""}"></label><div class="err">${esc(S.tnote)}</div></div>
<form class="card" id="bf" novalidate><h2>${t("inf")}</h2>${inp("n",t("name"),"text",'autocomplete="name"')}${inp("p",t("ph"),"tel",'inputmode="tel" dir="ltr" placeholder="05XXXXXXXX"')}${inp("a",t("age"),"number",'inputmode="numeric" min="0" max="120"')}
<label>${t("rs")}<select name="r">${t("reason").map(o=>`<option>${o}</option>`).join("")}</select></label><div class="err">${esc(S.err)}</div><button class="btn" ${S.time?"":"disabled"}>${S.time?t("go"):t("pick")}</button></form>`}
const ICON=["🩺","👶","🤰","❤️","🦷","👁️","🧴","👂","🦴","🏥","🍬","🧠","💭","🩻"];
const W=S.w===""?DOCS:DOCS.filter(d=>d.w==S.w);
const wsel=`<div class="card"><div class="g2"><label style="margin:0">${t("w")}<select id="fw">${opts(WIL,S.w,t("allW"))}</select></label><label style="margin:0">${t("srD")}<input id="ds" value="${esc(S.ds)}" placeholder="${t("srD")}" autocomplete="off"></label></div></div>`;
const k=S.ds.trim().toLowerCase();
if(k){const r=W.filter(d=>d.name.toLowerCase().includes(k));return wsel+`<div class="card"><h2>${t("res")} (${r.length})</h2>${r.length?r.map(d=>`<div class="doc"><span class="av">${esc(d.name.replace(/^(Dr|د\.)\s*/,"").charAt(0))}</span><div><b>${esc(d.name)}</b><span class="pill">${sl(d.sp)}</span><small>${wl(d.w)} • ${esc(d.addr)}</small>${ph(d)}</div><button class="btn sm" data-sel="${d.id}">${t("book")}</button></div>`).join(""):`<div class="empty">${t("none")}</div>`}</div>`}
if(S.sp==="")return wsel+`<div class="card"><h2>${t("sp")}</h2><div class="specs">${SPEC.map((s,i)=>`<button class="spec" data-sp="${i}"><span class="ic">${ICON[i]}</span><b>${s[L()]}</b><small>${W.filter(d=>d.sp==i).length} ${t("docsN")}</small></button>`).join("")}</div></div>`;
const l=W.filter(d=>d.sp==S.sp);
return wsel+`<div class="card"><button class="link" id="spb">← ${t("back")}</button><h2 style="margin:10px 0 14px"><span style="font-size:1.4rem">${ICON[S.sp]}</span> ${sl(S.sp)} (${l.length})</h2>${l.length?l.map(d=>`<div class="doc"><span class="av">${esc(d.name.replace(/^(Dr|د\.)\s*/,"").charAt(0))}</span><div><b>${esc(d.name)}</b><small>${wl(d.w)} • ${esc(d.addr)}</small>${ph(d)}</div>
<button class="btn sm" data-sel="${d.id}">${t("book")}</button></div>`).join(""):`<div class="empty">${t("none")}</div>`}</div>`}

function doctor(){
if(S.me)return account();
if(false){const d=DOCS.find(x=>x.id===S.me),a=BK.filter(b=>b.did===d.id).sort((x,y)=>(x.day+x.time).localeCompare(y.day+y.time));
return`<div class="card"><h2>${t("hello")} ${esc(d.name)}</h2><div class="sub">${t("prof")}</div><div class="row"><span>${t("sp")}</span><b>${sl(d.sp)}</b></div><div class="row"><span>${t("w")}</span><b>${wl(d.w)}</b></div>
<div class="row"><span>${t("addr")}</span><b>${esc(d.addr)}</b></div><div class="row"><span>${t("hrs")}</span><b dir="ltr">${d.from}:00 – ${d.to}:00</b></div>
<p class="sub" style="margin-top:12px">${t("live")} ${wl(d.w)} / ${sl(d.sp)}.</p><button class="btn ghost sm" id="out">${t("out")}</button></div>
<div class="card"><h2>${t("appts")} (${a.length})</h2>${a.length?a.map(b=>`<div class="row"><span><b>${esc(b.name)}</b><br><small dir="ltr">${esc(b.phone)}</small> • ${esc(b.reason)}</span><b>${b.day}<br>${b.time}</b></div>`).join(""):`<div class="empty">${t("noA")}</div>`}</div>`}
const lg=S.dm==="login";
return`<div class="card"><h2>${lg?t("login"):t("signup")}</h2><form id="${lg?"lf":"sf"}" novalidate>
${lg?inp("e",t("email"),"email",'autocomplete="email" dir="ltr"')+inp("pw",t("pw1"),"password",'autocomplete="current-password"'):
inp("dn",t("dn"))+`<div class="g2"><label>${t("w")}<select name="w">${opts(WIL,S.f.w??"","—")}</select></label><label>${t("sp")}<select name="sp">${opts(SPEC,S.f.sp??"","—")}</select></label></div>`+
inp("addr",t("addr"))+inp("lic",t("lic"),"text",'dir="ltr"')+inp("ph",t("ph"),"tel",'inputmode="tel" autocomplete="tel" dir="ltr" placeholder="05XXXXXXXX"')+`<div class="g2">${hrs("from",t("from"),9)}${hrs("to",t("to"),16)}</div>`+
inp("e",t("email"),"email",'autocomplete="email" dir="ltr"')+pwInp("pw",t("pw"),'autocomplete="new-password"')+pwInp("pw2",t("pw2"),'autocomplete="new-password"')}
<div class="err">${esc(S.err)}</div><button class="btn">${lg?t("login"):t("create")}</button></form>
<p style="text-align:center;margin:14px 0 0">${lg?t("noAcc"):t("haveAcc")} <button class="link" id="dm">${lg?t("signup"):t("login")}</button></p></div><p class="sub" style="text-align:center">${t("note")}</p>`}

const DRUGS=["Doliprane 1000 mg","Amoxicilline 500 mg","Augmentin 1 g","Glucophage 850 mg","Amlor 5 mg","Ventoline spray","Oméprazole 20 mg","Spasfon"];
let DD=ld("scm_dd",{});const svd=()=>sv("scm_dd",DD);
const dd=id=>DD[id]||(DD[id]={pts:[],sms:[],bal:20,draft:{pid:"",items:[{d:"",dose:"",dur:""}]}});
function addPt(did,name,phone,age){const x=dd(did);if(x.pts.some(q=>q.phone===phone))return;x.pts.push({id:Date.now()+x.pts.length,file:"P-"+String(x.pts.length+1).padStart(4,"0"),name,phone,age,bd:"",ins:"CNAS"});svd()}
const today=()=>dkey(new Date());
const myBk=id=>BK.filter(b=>b.did===id).sort((a,b)=>(a.day+a.time.padStart(5,"0")).localeCompare(b.day+b.time.padStart(5,"0")));
const stSel=b=>`<select data-st="${b.id}">${["SCHEDULED","CONFIRMED","WAITING","COMPLETED","CANCELLED","NO_SHOW"].map(s=>`<option value="${s}" ${(b.st||"SCHEDULED")===s?"selected":""}>${t("s_"+s)}</option>`).join("")}</select>`;
const apT=l=>l.length?`<div class="tw"><table><tr><th>${t("dt")}</th><th>${t("pat")}</th><th>${t("rs")}</th><th>${t("st")}</th></tr>${l.map(b=>`<tr><td dir="ltr">${b.day} ${b.time}</td><td>${esc(b.name)}${b.age!=null?" ("+b.age+")":""}</td><td>${esc(b.reason)}</td><td>${stSel(b)}</td></tr>`).join("")}</table></div>`:`<div class="empty">${t("noA")}</div>`;
const DEMO_PH={s1:"0550 00 00 01",s2:"0661 00 00 02",s3:"0770 00 00 03",s4:"0550 00 00 04",s5:"0661 00 00 05",s6:"0770 00 00 06"};
const ph=d=>{const n=d.phone||DEMO_PH[d.id];return n?`<small>📞 <a dir="ltr" href="tel:${dg(n)}" style="color:var(--acc);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600">${esc(n)}</a></small>`:""};
function blkCard(d){const k=S.bd||today(),bl=(d.blocked||{})[k]||[],bk=BK.filter(b=>b.did===d.id&&b.day===k).map(b=>b.time);
return`<div class="card"><h2>${t("blk")}</h2><div class="sub">${t("blkSub")}</div>
<label>${t("blkDay")}<input type="date" id="bdt" value="${k}" min="${today()}" max="${dkey(new Date(Date.now()+90*864e5))}"></label>
<div class="slots">${slots(d,d.step||30).map(x=>bk.includes(x)?`<button class="slot" disabled title="${t("booked")}">${x} •</button>`:`<button class="slot${bl.includes(x)?" blk":""}" data-bs="${x}">${x}</button>`).join("")}</div>
<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px"><button class="btn ghost sm" id="blkAll">${t("blkAll")}</button><button class="btn ghost sm" id="blkNone">${t("blkNone")}</button></div></div>`}
function account(){const d=DOCS.find(q=>q.id===S.me),x=dd(d.id),A=myBk(d.id),V=S.dt;
const nav=["dash","pts","agenda","rx","smsT"].map(k=>`<button data-dt="${k}" aria-pressed="${V===k}">${t(k)}</button>`).join("");let h="";
if(V==="dash"){const td=A.filter(b=>b.day===today());
h=`<div class="stats"><div class="stat"><b>${td.length}</b><span>${t("today")}</span></div><div class="stat"><b>${x.pts.length}</b><span>${t("total")}</span></div><div class="stat"><b>${A.filter(b=>b.st==="WAITING").length}</b><span>${t("wait")}</span></div><div class="stat"><b>${x.bal}</b><span>${t("bal")}</span></div></div>
<div class="card"><h2>${t("today")}</h2>${apT(td)}</div>
<div class="card"><h2>${t("wh")}</h2><div class="sub">${t("autoSave")}</div>
<div class="seg">${[0,1,2,3,4,5,6].map(i=>`<button data-wd="${i}" aria-pressed="${(d.days||[0,1,2,3,4]).includes(i)}">${new Date(2024,0,7+i).toLocaleDateString(loc(),{weekday:"short"})}</button>`).join("")}</div>
<div class="g2"><label>${t("from")}<select id="wf">${Array.from({length:15},(_,i)=>i+7).map(z=>`<option value="${z}" ${d.from==z?"selected":""}>${z}:00</option>`).join("")}</select></label>
<label>${t("to")}<select id="wt">${Array.from({length:15},(_,i)=>i+7).map(z=>`<option value="${z}" ${d.to==z?"selected":""}>${z}:00</option>`).join("")}</select></label></div>
<label style="margin-bottom:6px">${t("stepL")}</label><div class="seg">${[15,30,60].map(n=>`<button data-ws="${n}" aria-pressed="${(d.step||30)===n}">${n} ${t("min")}</button>`).join("")}</div><div class="err">${esc(S.err)}</div></div>
${blkCard(d)}
<div class="card"><h2>${t("hello")} ${esc(d.name)}</h2><div class="sub">${sl(d.sp)} • ${wl(d.w)} • ${esc(d.addr)} • <span dir="ltr">${d.from}:00–${d.to}:00</span>${d.phone?` • <span dir="ltr">${esc(d.phone)}</span>`:""}</div><button class="btn ghost sm" id="out">${t("out")}</button></div>`}
else if(V==="pts"){const k=S.q.toLowerCase(),l=x.pts.filter(q=>(q.name+q.phone).toLowerCase().includes(k));
h=`<form class="card" id="ptf" novalidate><h2>${t("add")}</h2><div class="g2">${inp("n",t("name"))}${inp("p",t("ph"),"tel",'inputmode="tel" dir="ltr"')}${inp("bd",t("bd"),"date")}<label>${t("ins")}<select name="ins"><option>CNAS</option><option>CASNOS</option><option>NONE</option></select></label></div><div class="err">${esc(S.err)}</div><button class="btn">${t("add")}</button></form>
<div class="card"><label><input id="q" value="${esc(S.q)}" placeholder="${t("srch")}"></label>${l.length?`<div class="tw"><table><tr><th>#</th><th>${t("name")}</th><th>${t("age")}</th><th>${t("ph")}</th><th>${t("ins")}</th><th></th></tr>${l.map(q=>`<tr><td>${q.file}</td><td>${esc(q.name)}</td><td>${q.bd?new Date().getFullYear()-+q.bd.slice(0,4):(q.age??"—")}</td><td dir="ltr">${esc(q.phone)}</td><td>${q.ins}</td><td><button class="btn ghost sm" data-rx="${q.id}">${t("rx")}</button></td></tr>`).join("")}</table></div>`:`<div class="empty">${t("nodata")}</div>`}</div>`}
else if(V==="agenda"){h=`<form class="card" id="apf" novalidate><h2>${t("book2")}</h2><div class="g2"><label>${t("pat")}<select name="pid">${x.pts.map(q=>`<option value="${q.id}">${esc(q.name)}</option>`).join("")}</select></label>${inp("at",t("dt"),"datetime-local")}</div>${inp("rs2",t("rs"))}<div class="err">${esc(S.err)}</div><button class="btn" ${x.pts.length?"":"disabled"}>${t("book2")}</button></form><div class="card">${apT(A)}</div>`}
else if(V==="rx"){const dr=x.draft,pt=x.pts.find(q=>q.id==dr.pid);
h=`<div class="card noprint"><label>${t("pat")}<select id="rp"><option value="">${t("choose")}</option>${x.pts.map(q=>`<option value="${q.id}" ${q.id==dr.pid?"selected":""}>${esc(q.name)}</option>`).join("")}</select></label><datalist id="dl">${DRUGS.map(z=>`<option value="${z}">`).join("")}</datalist>
${dr.items.map((it,i)=>`<div class="g3"><label>${t("drug")}<input list="dl" data-i="${i}" data-f="d" value="${esc(it.d)}"></label><label>${t("dose")}<input data-i="${i}" data-f="dose" value="${esc(it.dose)}"></label><label>${t("dur")}<input data-i="${i}" data-f="dur" value="${esc(it.dur)}"></label></div>`).join("")}
<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap"><button class="btn ghost sm" id="ad">${t("addDrug")}</button><button class="btn sm" id="pr">${t("print")}</button></div></div>
<div class="card"><div class="rx"><header><div><h3>${esc(d.name)}</h3><small>${sl(d.sp)}<br>${esc(d.addr)}، ${wl(d.w)}</small></div><small>${t("date")}<br><b>${new Date().toLocaleDateString(loc())}</b></small></header>
<p><b>${t("pat")}:</b> ${pt?esc(pt.name):"……………"}</p><ol>${dr.items.filter(i=>i.d).map(i=>`<li><b>${esc(i.d)}</b><br>${esc(i.dose)}${i.dur?" — "+esc(i.dur):""}</li>`).join("")||"<li>……………</li>"}</ol><footer><span>${esc(d.name)}</span><span>${t("sign")}</span></footer></div></div>`}
else{h=`<div class="stats"><div class="stat"><b>${x.bal}</b><span>${t("bal")}</span></div></div><div class="card"><div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap"><button class="btn sm" id="rem">${t("rem")}</button><button class="btn ghost sm" data-buy="50">${t("buy")} 50</button><button class="btn ghost sm" data-buy="200">${t("buy")} 200</button></div><div class="err" style="margin-top:8px">${esc(S.err)}</div></div>
<div class="card"><h2>${t("log")}</h2>${x.sms.length?`<div class="tw"><table><tr><th>${t("date")}</th><th>${t("ph")}</th><th>${t("msg")}</th></tr>${x.sms.slice().reverse().map(m=>`<tr><td dir="ltr">${m.at}</td><td dir="ltr">${esc(m.to)}</td><td>${esc(m.body)}</td></tr>`).join("")}</table></div>`:`<div class="empty">${t("nodata")}</div>`}</div>`}
return`<div class="sub-tabs noprint">${nav}</div>`+h}
const CONTACT={phone:"0780741372",whatsapp:"",email:"smartclinicdz@gmail.com",facebook:"https://web.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61595772211296",instagram:"",tiktok:"",telegram:"",website:""};
let CT={...CONTACT,...ld("scm_ct",{})};
const safeU=u=>/^https:\/\/[^\s"'<>]+$/i.test(u||"")?u:"";
const dg=s=>(s||"").replace(/[^\d+]/g,"");
function footer(){const c=CT,a=[];
if(dg(c.phone))a.push(`<a href="tel:${dg(c.phone)}" dir="ltr">📞 ${esc(c.phone)}</a>`);
if(dg(c.whatsapp))a.push(`<a href="https://wa.me/${dg(c.whatsapp).replace(/^\+/,"")}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">💬 WhatsApp</a>`);
if(/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(c.email||""))a.push(`<a href="mailto:${esc(c.email)}" dir="ltr">✉️ ${esc(c.email)}</a>`);
[["facebook","📘 Facebook"],["instagram","📸 Instagram"],["tiktok","🎵 TikTok"],["telegram","✈️ Telegram"],["website","🌐 Web"]].forEach(([k,l])=>{const u=safeU(c[k]);if(u)a.push(`<a href="${esc(u)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${l}</a>`)});
$("#ft").innerHTML=a.length?`<div class="ctc"><b>${t("ctT")}</b><div>${a.join("")}</div></div>`:""}
function devCard(){const f=(k,l,ph="")=>`<label>${l}<input name="c_${k}" value="${esc(CT[k]||"")}" placeholder="${ph}" dir="ltr"></label>`;
return`<form class="card" id="cf" novalidate style="border:2px dashed var(--acc)"><h2>🛠 ${t("devT")}</h2><div class="sub">${t("devNote")}</div><div class="g2">${f("phone",t("ph"),"05XXXXXXXX")}${f("whatsapp","WhatsApp","213XXXXXXXXX")}${f("email",t("email"),"name@mail.com")}${f("facebook","Facebook","https://facebook.com/...")}${f("instagram","Instagram","https://instagram.com/...")}${f("tiktok","TikTok","https://tiktok.com/@...")}${f("telegram","Telegram","https://t.me/...")}${f("website","Website","https://...")}</div>
<label>${t("devCode")}<textarea readonly rows="4" style="font:12px monospace;padding:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);direction:ltr">${esc("const CONTACT="+JSON.stringify(CT)+";")}</textarea></label>
<div style="display:flex;gap:8px"><button class="btn sm">${t("devSave")}</button><button type="button" class="btn ghost sm" id="cfr">${t("devReset")}</button></div></form>`}
function render(){document.documentElement.lang=S.lang;document.documentElement.dir=S.lang==="ar"?"rtl":"ltr";$("#lg").textContent=t("lg");
$("#tabs").innerHTML=["p","d"].map(m=>`<button data-m="${m}" aria-pressed="${S.mode===m}">${t(m)}</button>`).join("");
$("#app").innerHTML=(S.dev?devCard():"")+(S.mode==="p"?patient():doctor());footer()}
const go=f=>{S.err="";f();render()};
document.addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("button");if(!b)return;const d=b.dataset;
if(b.dataset.togglePw){e.preventDefault();const input=b.parentElement.querySelector("input");const show=input.type==="password";input.type=show?"text":"password";b.textContent=show?"إخفاء":"إظهار";b.setAttribute("aria-label",show?"إخفاء كلمة المرور":"إظهار كلمة المرور");b.setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(show));return;}
if(b.id==="lg")go(()=>S.lang=S.lang==="ar"?"fr":"ar");
else if(d.m)go(()=>{S.mode=d.m;S.f={}});
else if(d.sel)go(()=>{S.sel=d.sel;S.note=S.tnote="";S.day=null;S.time=null;S.f={};scrollTo(0,0)});
else if(b.id==="bk")go(()=>{S.sel=null;S.f={}});
else if(d.day)go(()=>{S.day=d.day;S.time=null;S.note=S.tnote=""});
else if(d.t)go(()=>{S.time=d.t;S.tnote=""});
else if(b.id==="cfr")go(()=>{CT={...CONTACT};try{localStorage.removeItem("scm_ct")}catch(e){}});
else if(d.bs)go(()=>{const dc=DOCS.find(q=>q.id===S.me),k=S.bd||today();dc.blocked=dc.blocked||{};let a=dc.blocked[k]||[];
a=a.includes(d.bs)?a.filter(x=>x!==d.bs):[...a,d.bs];if(a.length)dc.blocked[k]=a;else delete dc.blocked[k];sv("scm_docs",DOCS)});
else if(b.id==="blkAll")go(()=>{const dc=DOCS.find(q=>q.id===S.me),k=S.bd||today(),bk=BK.filter(z=>z.did===dc.id&&z.day===k).map(z=>z.time);
dc.blocked=dc.blocked||{};dc.blocked[k]=slots(dc,dc.step||30).filter(x=>!bk.includes(x));sv("scm_docs",DOCS)});
else if(b.id==="blkNone")go(()=>{const dc=DOCS.find(q=>q.id===S.me);if(dc.blocked)delete dc.blocked[S.bd||today()];sv("scm_docs",DOCS)});
else if(d.ws)go(()=>{DOCS.find(q=>q.id===S.me).step=+d.ws;sv("scm_docs",DOCS)});
else if(d.wd)go(()=>{const dc=DOCS.find(q=>q.id===S.me);let a=dc.days||[0,1,2,3,4];const i=+d.wd;
if(a.includes(i)){if(a.length===1){S.err=t("minDay");return}a=a.filter(x=>x!==i)}else a=[...a,i].sort();dc.days=a;sv("scm_docs",DOCS)});
else if(b.id==="again")go(()=>{S.done=null;S.sel=null;S.f={}});
else if(b.id==="dm")go(()=>{S.dm=S.dm==="login"?"signup":"login";S.f={}});
else if(d.sp!==undefined)go(()=>{S.sp=d.sp;scrollTo(0,0)});
else if(b.id==="spb")go(()=>S.sp="");
else if(d.dt)go(()=>{S.dt=d.dt;S.f={};S.q=""});
else if(d.rx)go(()=>{dd(S.me).draft.pid=d.rx;svd();S.dt="rx";S.f={}});
else if(b.id==="ad")go(()=>{dd(S.me).draft.items.push({d:"",dose:"",dur:""});svd()});
else if(b.id==="pr")window.print();
else if(d.buy)go(()=>{dd(S.me).bal+=+d.buy;svd()});
else if(b.id==="rem")go(()=>{const x=dd(S.me),dc=DOCS.find(q=>q.id===S.me),tm=new Date();tm.setDate(tm.getDate()+1);const k=dkey(tm);
const l=myBk(S.me).filter(a=>a.day===k&&["SCHEDULED","CONFIRMED"].includes(a.st||"SCHEDULED"));
if(!l.length){S.err=t("noRem");return}if(x.bal<l.length){S.err=t("nobal");return}
const now=new Date().toLocaleString(loc(),{dateStyle:"short",timeStyle:"short"});
l.forEach(a=>{x.bal--;x.sms.push({at:now,to:a.phone,body:t("remMsg")+" "+a.day+" "+a.time+" — "+dc.name})});svd()});
else if(b.id==="out")go(()=>{S.me=null;S.f={};S.dt="dash"})});
document.addEventListener("input",e=>{const el=e.target;
if(el.id==="ds"){S.ds=el.value;const p=el.selectionStart;render();const n=$("#ds");n.focus();n.setSelectionRange(p,p)}
else if(el.id==="q"){S.q=el.value;const p=el.selectionStart;render();const n=$("#q");n.focus();n.setSelectionRange(p,p)}
else if(el.dataset.f){dd(S.me).draft.items[el.dataset.i][el.dataset.f]=el.value;svd();const i=el.dataset.i,f=el.dataset.f,p=el.selectionStart;render();const n=document.querySelector(`[data-i="${i}"][data-f="${f}"]`);n.focus();try{n.setSelectionRange(p,p)}catch(_){}}
else if(el.name)S.f[el.name]=el.value});
document.addEventListener("change",e=>{const el=e.target;if(el.id==="fw")go(()=>S.w=el.value);else if(el.id==="fs")go(()=>S.sp=el.value);
else if(el.id==="bdt")go(()=>S.bd=el.value||"");
else if(el.id==="wf"||el.id==="wt")go(()=>{const dc=DOCS.find(q=>q.id===S.me),v=+el.value,f=el.id==="wf"?v:dc.from,e2=el.id==="wt"?v:dc.to;
if(e2<=f){S.err=t("badHrs");return}dc.from=f;dc.to=e2;sv("scm_docs",DOCS)});
else if(el.id==="dp")go(()=>{const v=el.value,dt=new Date(v+"T00:00");S.tnote="";
if(!v||isNaN(dt)||dt<=new Date()||dt>Date.now()+90*864e5){S.note=t("badDate");return}
if(!((DOCS.find(q=>q.id===S.sel).days)||[0,1,2,3,4]).includes(dt.getDay())){S.note=t("closedDay");return}
S.day=v;S.time=null;S.note=""});
else if(el.id==="ct")go(()=>{const d=DOCS.find(q=>q.id===S.sel);if(!el.value)return;const[hh,mm]=el.value.split(":").map(Number),m=hh*60+mm;
if(m<d.from*60||m>d.to*60-15){S.tnote=t("outHrs")+" "+d.from+":00–"+d.to+":00";S.time=null;return}
const x=hh+":"+String(mm).padStart(2,"0");if(taken(d,S.day,x)){S.tnote=t("busy");S.time=null;return}S.tnote="";S.time=x});
else if(el.dataset.st){BK.find(q=>q.id==el.dataset.st).st=el.value;sv("scm_bk",BK);go(()=>{})}
else if(el.id==="rp"){dd(S.me).draft.pid=el.value;svd();go(()=>{})}else if(el.name)S.f[el.name]=el.value});
document.addEventListener("submit",async e=>{e.preventDefault();const id=e.target.id,F=Object.fromEntries(new FormData(e.target));Object.assign(S.f,F);S.err="";
if(id==="bf"){const n=(F.n||"").trim(),p=(F.p||"").replace(/[\s.-]/g,"");
if(n.length<3)S.err=t("eN");else if(!/^0[567]\d{8}$/.test(p))S.err=t("eP");
else if(F.a===""||!Number.isInteger(+F.a)||+F.a<0||+F.a>120)S.err=t("eA");
else if(!S.time||taken(DOCS.find(q=>q.id===S.sel),S.day,S.time)){S.err=t("busy");S.time=null;}else{const r={id:Date.now(),did:S.sel,name:n,phone:p,age:+F.a,reason:F.r,day:S.day,time:S.time,st:"SCHEDULED",ref:"SC-"+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7).toUpperCase()};BK.push(r);sv("scm_bk",BK);addPt(S.sel,n,p,r.age);S.done=r;S.f={}}}
else if(id==="cf"){const o={};for(const k of Object.keys(CONTACT))o[k]=(F["c_"+k]||"").trim();CT=o;sv("scm_ct",o);S.f={}}
else if(id==="ptf"){const n=(F.n||"").trim(),p=(F.p||"").replace(/[\s.-]/g,"");
if(n.length<3)S.err=t("eN");else if(!/^0[567]\d{8}$/.test(p))S.err=t("eP");
else{const x=dd(S.me);x.pts.push({id:Date.now(),file:"P-"+String(x.pts.length+1).padStart(4,"0"),name:n,phone:p,bd:F.bd||"",ins:F.ins});svd();S.f={}}}
else if(id==="apf"){const x=dd(S.me),pt=x.pts.find(q=>q.id==F.pid);
if(!pt||!F.at)S.err=t("eW");else{const[day,tm]=F.at.split("T");BK.push({id:Date.now(),did:S.me,name:pt.name,phone:pt.phone,reason:F.rs2||"",day,time:(+tm.slice(0,2))+":"+tm.slice(3,5),st:"SCHEDULED",ref:"SC-MAN"});sv("scm_bk",BK);S.f={}}}
else if(id==="lf"){const h=await sha(F.pw||"");const d=DOCS.find(x=>x.e&&x.e===(F.e||"").trim().toLowerCase()&&x.h===h);if(d){S.me=d.id;S.f={}}else S.err=t("eL")}
else if(id==="sf"){const em=(F.e||"").trim().toLowerCase();
if(!F.dn?.trim()||!F.addr?.trim()||!F.lic?.trim()||F.w===""||F.sp===""||(F.pw||"").length<6)S.err=t("eW");
else if(!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(em))S.err=t("eE");else if(!/^0[567]\d{8}$/.test((F.ph||"").replace(/[\s.-]/g,"")))S.err=t("eP");
else if(F.pw!==F.pw2)S.err=t("ePw2");
else if(DOCS.some(x=>x.e===em))S.err=t("eX");
else if(+F.to<=+F.from)S.err=t("eW");
else{const d={id:"d"+Date.now(),name:F.dn.trim(),sp:+F.sp,w:+F.w,addr:F.addr.trim(),lic:F.lic.trim(),phone:(F.ph||"").replace(/[\s.-]/g,""),from:+F.from,to:+F.to,e:em,h:await sha(F.pw)};DOCS.push(d);sv("scm_docs",DOCS);S.me=d.id;S.f={}}}
render();if(S.done)scrollTo(0,0)});
addEventListener("hashchange",()=>{S.dev=location.hash==="#dev";render()});
render();
</script>
</body>
</html>
